# How to sign up

1. Read the **Directory of Departments and Agencies** and choose one entry.
2. Write your name next to it. **One person per entry.**
3. If your first choice is taken, choose another. There are 27 entries and fewer students.

**The instructor plays every entry left blank.** Unclaimed entries still answer requests, set conditions and refuse, as a student owner would.

You can claim an outside agency or a resident group instead of a city-county department.

# City-county departments

These must take part in the spec.

| ID | Department | Student | If blank |
|------|-----------------------------|------------------------------|-----------|
| D-01 | Mayor / County Executive's Office | | Instructor |
| D-02 | City-County Council and Budget Committee | | Instructor |
| D-03 | City Manager / Administration | | Instructor |
| D-04 | Human Services | | Instructor |
| D-05 | Housing Division (EDHD) | | Instructor |
| D-06 | Planning, Building and Land Use | | Instructor |
| D-07 | Address Office and GIS | | Instructor |
| D-08 | Finance, Tax, Assessor and Procurement | | Instructor |
| D-09 | Digital Service and Records | | Instructor |
| D-10 | Police, 911 and Emergency Management | | Instructor |
| D-11 | Fire Department | | Instructor |
| D-12 | Public Health | | Instructor |
| D-13 | Parks, Recreation and Cultural Affairs | | Instructor |
| D-14 | Transportation and Public Works | | Instructor |
| D-15 | Clerk, Civil Rights and Appeals | | Instructor |

: Table 1. City-county departments

# Outside agencies

Independent bodies that may join, join on conditions, or refuse. A-01 to A-08 always have an owner. A-09 takes part only if a student claims it.

| ID | Agency | Student | If blank |
|------|-----------------------------|------------------------------|-----------|
| A-01 | East Detroit Unified School District | | Instructor |
| A-02 | East Detroit Public Library District | | Instructor |
| A-03 | East Detroit Water and Sewer Authority | | Instructor |
| A-04 | Regional Transportation District (RTD) | | Instructor |
| A-05 | State of Colorado Human Services and State IT | | Instructor |
| A-06 | East Detroit Regional Housing Authority | | Instructor |
| A-07 | East Detroit County Court | | Instructor |
| A-08 | East Detroit Health and Hospital Authority | | Instructor |
| A-09 | East Detroit Health System (optional) | | Not represented |

: Table 2. Outside agencies

# Resident groups

| ID | Group | Student | If blank |
|------|-----------------------------|------------------------------|-----------|
| R-01 | Renter and Tenant Advocacy Council | | Instructor |
| R-02 | Old Watkins and Agricultural Landholders Alliance | | Instructor |
| R-03 | Workers and Disability Access Coalition | | Instructor |

: Table 3. Resident groups

# After you sign up

Reading 4, *The Municipal Project Brief*, lists what to bring to the first session.
